gaps: retryable convention: true only where the 'Next steps' column says to attempt the payment again unchanged; false where it says to use another card / alternative payment method; null otherwise (including 'try again using the correct X', which is a retry with corrected input).
Category mapping is our own classification; Stripe does not publish categories.

31 codes kept (slightly above the ~25 cap) from the card decline codes table of 50; omitted PIN/card-present codes, deprecated codes (do_not_try_again, try_again_later) and other generic 'unknown reason' variants.
The testing page says Radar-blocked payments produce an error code of 'fraud'; the exact decline_code for Radar blocks on 4100000000000019 is not stated on the testing page, so it is not asserted.
No cardholder-name, email or amount values control sandbox outcomes on the testing page (besides location-formatted emails for Checkout, not card outcomes).
